description: Experimental grid of the paper: seeds, token budgets, pretraining conditions, evaluation sets, probe, readouts, baselines, contrasts, statistics, noise settings and runtime measurement.

holdout_rules.positives: EPDnew Hs 006 hg38, chr9+chr10, TATA-box=0, window -200..+50 around 1-based SGA TSS
holdout_rules.negatives: refGene NM_ longest transcript per gene, after first exon, sense orientation, uniform non-overlapping, seed 2026, n_neg=round(n_pos*4119/4915)
holdout_rules.exclusions: any >=1 bp overlap with GB promoter-task intervals; any N; negatives also +/-1000 bp around every EPD 006 TSS and selected positives
holdout_rules.sensitivity: positives with no GB positive interval within 10 kb

probe.head: LinearHead
probe.threshold: first argmax val MCC over linspace(0.02,0.98,97); prob>=thr

cnn.blocks: 3x Conv1d(32,k=8)+ReLU+BN, MaxPool2 after blocks 1-2, GAP, Linear(32,1)

statistics.multiplicity: Holm across C1-C4 within each evaluation set
statistics.decision: persists if Holm-adjusted permutation p<0.05 and 95% CI excludes 0
statistics.sample_uncertainty: paired bootstrap over sequences (holdout: overlap clusters), 2000 resamples, thresholds frozen

noise.encoders: qssm_allpos at the base budget (all settings); endpoint, dense8 and allpos at the ten-fold budget with their untrained registers (noiseless, two-qubit 1e-3, moderate)
noise.policy_B: probe+threshold refit on noisy train/val, largest level per factor + combined
noise.note: hypothetical sensitivity, not a device model

runtime.qpu: device time from stated hypothetical gate and reset durations
